annual_report_takeaways: Full-year 2025 revenue / operating income / AFFO per share: `$9.217B` / `$1.848B` / `$38.33`
Q1 2026 revenue / operating income / adjusted EBITDA / AFFO per share: `$2.444B` / `$577M` / `$1.245B` / `$10.79`
Q2 2026 revenue / operating income / adjusted EBITDA / AFFO per share: `$2.625B` / `$665M` / `$1.396B` / `$11.78`
Q4 2025 monthly recurring revenue grew `10%` year over year; Q1 2026 MRR grew `12%` as reported; Q2 2026 MRR grew `11%`

Q4 2025 annualized gross bookings reached a record `$474M`; Q1 2026 delivered the largest first-quarter annualized gross bookings in company history; Q2 2026 annualized gross bookings grew `23%` year over year
Equinix surpassed `500,000` interconnections in Q4 2025 and added a record `9,700` net interconnections in Q2 2026

signal_takeaways: Real estate is fragmenting: Equinix shows why the property universe cannot be treated as a simple office, retail, or housing cycle when network-dense data-center assets are compounding under AI and cloud demand
Interconnection matters: this is not just powered-shell capacity; the moat is the ecosystem of customers, clouds, networks, and cross-connect density
AI demand is showing up physically: Equinix gives the archive a concrete example of AI demand translating into recurring real-estate and infrastructure economics
